items.title: CMU feature on its Florida connections, from Space Coast rovers to a new campus
items.summary_en: A Carnegie Mellon University news story from November 2026 looks at the university's ties to Florida. According to its title, the story covers rover work linked to the Space Coast and a planned new campus. Only the title and URL were visible, so the robotics content is not confirmed.
items.notes: Date is month-level only (taken from the URL path). Page body not read because direct fetch was blocked. This is a university-wide story, not an RI news-page item, so its relevance to the RI is uncertain. Summary is based on the title only.

coverage_note: Low coverage. Direct WebFetch of www.ri.cmu.edu failed (host not resolvable, so it likely needs to be added to the session's allowed network domains). I could only use web search snippets, so I could not read the RI news page or confirm any item published 2026-11-04 to 2026-11-14. A search summary claimed a DARPA Triage Challenge story (Team Chiron) dated 2026-11-06. A follow-up search showed the ri.cmu.edu article 'Team Chiron advances to final phase of DARPA Triage Challenge' is dated 11/11/2025, so it is out of the window and I excluded it. The same snippets mentioned a Nov 2 feature on the Robotics Innovation Center (https://www.ri.cmu.edu/inside-cmus-robotics-innovation-center/) and a Nov 3 satellite-servicing feature. I could not verify the dates or content of either, so I did not list them as items. A satellite-servicing search found only 2022 coverage. Upcoming RI events seen in search snippets and not verified: PhD thesis proposals on Nov 16 and Nov 20, and an RI Seminar on Nov 20. These are events, not research results. Recommend re-running once ri.cmu.edu is reachable.
